description: This file defines the Template class for handling template rendering, variable substitution, and file management within the eGroupWare API.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A class providing template file management, variable substitution, and error handling for the eGroupWare API.

methods.name: Template
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the Template object with optional root directory and unknown variable handling mode.

methods.name: set_root
methods.description: Sets the root directory for template files.

methods.name: set_unknowns
methods.description: Sets how to handle undefined variables ('remove', 'comment', 'keep').

methods.name: set_file
methods.description: Associates file handles with filenames for template loading.

methods.name: set_block
methods.description: Extracts a block from a template and assigns it to a variable.

methods.name: set_var
methods.description: Sets variable values for substitution, supports both single and multiple variables.

methods.name: subst
methods.description: Performs variable substitution within a template handle.

methods.name: psubst
methods.description: Prints the result of substitution for a template handle.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Generates a variable by substituting a template handle, optionally appending.

methods.name: pparse
methods.description: Prints the result of parse.

methods.name: fp
methods.description: Performs parse and then finishes the string.

methods.name: pfp
methods.description: Performs parse, finishes, and prints the result.

methods.name: get_vars
methods.description: Returns all variables and their current values.

methods.name: get_var
methods.description: Retrieves the value(s) of specified variable(s).

methods.name: get_undefined
methods.description: Finds variables in a template that are undefined.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes a string by handling undefined variables according to the mode.

methods.name: p
methods.description: Prints the value of a variable after finishing.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the finished value of a variable.

methods.name: filename
methods.description: Resolves a filename relative to the root, with optional existence check.

methods.name: varname
methods.description: Wraps a variable name in braces for substitution.

methods.name: loadfile
methods.description: Loads a template file into the object by handle.

methods.name: halt
methods.description: Handles errors, outputs message, and terminates execution.

methods.name: haltmsg
methods.description: Outputs an error message.
